parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set system analytics nqa scheduler-group.template: set system analytics nqa scheduler-group [parameter1] prober [parameter2] test [parameter3] reflector [parameter4]
set system analytics nqa scheduler-group.command: set system analytics nqa scheduler-group 1 prober 1 test 1 reflector 1
set system analytics nqa scheduler-group.explanation: 配置NQA调度器组中的探针、测试和反射器。

set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family inet address 10.1.3.1/24
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 0 family inet address 10.1.2.2/24
set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

set interfaces ge-0/0/1.1 unit 0 family.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/1.1 unit 0 family.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/1.1 unit 0 family inet address 10.1.3.2/24
set interfaces ge-0/0/1.1 unit 0 family.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

set interfaces ge-0/0/1.1 unit 0 family.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet filter input [parameter3]
set interfaces ge-0/0/1.1 unit 0 family.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/1.1 unit 0 family inet filter input TEST-FLOW
set interfaces ge-0/0/1.1 unit 0 family.explanation: 配置接口的输入过滤器。

set firewall family inet filter TEST-FLO.template: set firewall family inet filter [parameter1] term [parameter2] from source-address [parameter3]
set firewall family inet filter TEST-FLO.command: set firewall family inet filter TEST-FLOW term 1 from source-address 10.1.1.1
set firewall family inet filter TEST-FLO.explanation: 配置防火墙过滤器的源地址条件。

set firewall family inet filter TEST-FLO.template: set firewall family inet filter [parameter1] term [parameter2] from destination-address [parameter3]
set firewall family inet filter TEST-FLO.command: set firewall family inet filter TEST-FLOW term 1 from destination-address 10.1.3.2
set firewall family inet filter TEST-FLO.explanation: 配置防火墙过滤器的目的地址条件。

set firewall family inet filter TEST-FLO.template: set firewall family inet filter [parameter1] term [parameter2] then accept
set firewall family inet filter TEST-FLO.command: set firewall family inet filter TEST-FLOW term 1 then accept
set firewall family inet filter TEST-FLO.explanation: 配置防火墙过滤器的接受动作。

set firewall family inet filter TEST-FLO.template: set firewall family inet filter [parameter1] term [parameter2] then reject
set firewall family inet filter TEST-FLO.command: set firewall family inet filter TEST-FLOW term 2 then reject
set firewall family inet filter TEST-FLO.explanation: 配置防火墙过滤器的拒绝动作。

set class-of-service scheduler TEST-POLI.explanation: 配置服务质量调度器的带宽限制。
